title: Transcatheter Edge-to-Edge Repair (TEER) for Mitral Valve Regurgitation
item_service_description:
<p><strong>A. General</strong></p>
<p>Transcatheter Edge-to-Edge Repair (TEER) of the mitral valve is used in the treatment of mitral regurgitation. TEER approximates the anterior and posterior mitral valve leaflets by grasping them with a clipping device in an approach similar to a treatment developed in cardiac surgery called the Alfieri stitch.</p>
